const SIDES=("top", "right", "bottom", "left")
const INITIAL=Dict(
    "display"=>"block",
    "position"=>"static",
    "box-sizing"=>"content-box",
    "width"=>"auto",
    "height"=>"auto",
    "min-width"=>"0",
    "min-height"=>"0",
    "max-width"=>"none",
    "max-height"=>"none",
    "flex-direction"=>"row",
    "flex-wrap"=>"nowrap",
    "justify-content"=>"start",
    "align-items"=>"stretch",
    "align-self"=>"auto",
    "row-gap"=>"0",
    "column-gap"=>"0",
    "order"=>"0",
    "flex-grow"=>"0",
    "flex-shrink"=>"1",
    "flex-basis"=>"auto",
    "grid-template-columns"=>"none",
    "grid-template-rows"=>"none",
    "grid-column"=>"auto",
    "grid-row"=>"auto",
)
for side in SIDES
    INITIAL[side]="auto"
    for kind in ("margin", "padding", "border")
        INITIAL["$kind-$side"]="0"
    end
end
const CHOICES=Dict(
    "display"=>("block", "flex", "grid", "none"),
    "position"=>("static", "relative", "absolute"),
    "box-sizing"=>("content-box", "border-box"),
    "flex-direction"=>("row", "row-reverse", "column", "column-reverse"),
    "flex-wrap"=>("nowrap", "wrap"),
    "justify-content"=>("start", "end", "center", "space-between", "space-around", "space-evenly"),
    "align-items"=>("stretch", "start", "end", "center"),
    "align-self"=>("auto", "stretch", "start", "end", "center"),
)
natural_token(s) = occursin(r"\A[0-9]{1,3}\z", s)
positive_token(s) = natural_token(s) && parse(Int, s)>0
signed_token(s) = natural_token(startswith(s, "-") ? s[2:end] : s)
percent_token(s) = endswith(s, "%") && natural_token(s[1:(end-1)])
fr_token(s) = endswith(s, "fr") && positive_token(s[1:(end-2)])
function gridline_valid(t)
    t==["auto"] && return true
    length(t)==1 && return positive_token(t[1])
    length(t)==2 && return t[1]=="span" && positive_token(t[2])
    length(t)==3 && return positive_token(t[1]) &&
           t[2]=="/" &&
           positive_token(t[3]) &&
           parse(Int, t[1])<parse(Int, t[3])
    length(t)==4 && return positive_token(t[1]) && t[2]=="/" && t[3]=="span" && positive_token(t[4])
    false
end
known_property(p) = haskey(INITIAL, p) || p in ("margin", "padding", "border", "gap")
function valid_longhand(p, t)
    if p in ("grid-template-columns", "grid-template-rows")
        return t==["none"] || all(s->s=="auto" || natural_token(s) || fr_token(s), t)
    end
    p in ("grid-column", "grid-row") && return gridline_valid(t)
    length(t)==1 || return false
    s=t[1]
    haskey(CHOICES, p) && return s in CHOICES[p]
    p in ("width", "height", "flex-basis") &&
        return s=="auto" || natural_token(s) || percent_token(s)
    p in ("min-width", "min-height") && return natural_token(s) || percent_token(s)
    p in ("max-width", "max-height") && return s=="none" || natural_token(s) || percent_token(s)
    startswith(p, "border-") && return s in ("0", "1")
    p in SIDES && return s=="auto" || signed_token(s)
    p=="order" && return signed_token(s)
    natural_token(s)
end
function expanddecl(p, value)
    t=String.(split(value, ' '))
    if haskey(INITIAL, p)
        return valid_longhand(p, t) ? [p=>value] : nothing
    end
    if p=="gap"
        1<=length(t)<=2 && all(natural_token, t) || return nothing
        return ["row-gap"=>t[1], "column-gap"=>t[end]]
    end
    if p in ("margin", "padding", "border")
        1<=length(t)<=4 && all(s->valid_longhand("$p-top", [s]), t) || return nothing
        picks=((1, 1, 1, 1), (1, 2, 1, 2), (1, 2, 3, 2), (1, 2, 3, 4))[length(t)]
        return ["$p-$(SIDES[i])"=>t[picks[i]] for i in 1:4]
    end
    nothing
end
mutable struct CssElement
    tag::String
    id::String
    classes::Vector{String}
    text::Union{Nothing,String}
    parent::Int
    depth::Int
    children::Vector{Int}
    style::Dict{String,String}
    displayed::Bool
    cw::Int
    ch::Int
    lines::Vector{String}
    rx::Int
    ry::Int
    x::Int
    y::Int
end
mutable struct Document
    width::Int
    height::Int
    elements::Vector{CssElement}
    intrinsic::Vector{Int}
end
edge(e, kind, side) = parse(Int, e.style["$kind-$side"])
function frame(e, horizontal)
    sides=horizontal ? ("left", "right") : ("top", "bottom")
    sum(edge(e, kind, side) for kind in ("padding", "border") for side in sides)
end
outer(e, horizontal) =
    frame(e, horizontal)+sum(
        edge(e, "margin", side) for side in (horizontal ? ("left", "right") : ("top", "bottom"))
    )
borderwidth(e) = e.cw+frame(e, true)
borderheight(e) = e.ch+frame(e, false)
flow(d, e) = [
    i for i in e.children if d.elements[i].displayed && d.elements[i].style["position"]!="absolute"
]
items(d, e) = sort(flow(d, e); by = i->(parse(Int, d.elements[i].style["order"]), i))
function resolvedlength(e, p, reference, horizontal)
    s=e.style[p]
    s in ("auto", "none") && return nothing
    if endswith(s, "%")
        reference===nothing && return nothing
        result=div(reference*parse(Int, s[1:(end-1)]), 100)
    else
        result=parse(Int, s)
    end
    e.style["box-sizing"]=="border-box" ? max(0, result-frame(e, horizontal)) : result
end
function constrain(e, value, horizontal, reference)
    axis=horizontal ? "width" : "height"
    lower=something(resolvedlength(e, "min-$axis", reference, horizontal), 0)
    upper=resolvedlength(e, "max-$axis", reference, horizontal)
    max(lower, upper===nothing ? value : min(value, upper))
end
inset(e, side) = e.style[side]=="auto" ? nothing : parse(Int, e.style[side])
function wrapwords(text, width)
    result=String[]
    for word in split(text, ' ')
        if !isempty(result) && length(result[end])+1+length(word)<=width
            result[end]*=" "*word
        else
            push!(result, String(word))
        end
    end
    result
end
gaptotal(gap, n) = gap*max(0, n-1)
function distribute(total, weights)
    denominator=sum(weights)
    shares=[div(total*w, denominator) for w in weights]
    remainder=total-sum(shares)
    for i in eachindex(weights)
        if remainder>0 && weights[i]>0
            shares[i]+=1
            remainder-=1
        end
    end
    shares
end
itemalign(e, child) =
    child.style["align-self"]=="auto" ? e.style["align-items"] : child.style["align-self"]
alignoffset(align, free) = free>0 ? (align=="end" ? free : align=="center" ? div(free, 2) : 0) : 0
function placechild!(e, child, x, y)
    child.rx=edge(e, "border", "left")+edge(e, "padding", "left")+x
    child.ry=edge(e, "border", "top")+edge(e, "padding", "top")+y
end
function gridrequest(value)
    t=split(value, ' ')
    t==["auto"] && return (0, 1)
    t[1]=="span" && return (0, parse(Int, t[2]))
    a=parse(Int, t[1])
    length(t)==1 && return (a, 1)
    (a, t[3]=="span" ? parse(Int, t[4]) : parse(Int, t[3])-a)
end
tracks(e, p) = e.style[p]=="none" ? String[] : String.(split(e.style[p], ' '))
columns(e) =
    e.style["grid-template-columns"]=="none" ? ["auto"] : tracks(e, "grid-template-columns")
function gridplacement(d, e, ordered)
    requests=[
        (
            gridrequest(d.elements[i].style["grid-row"])...,
            gridrequest(d.elements[i].style["grid-column"])...,
        ) for i in ordered
    ]
    nc=maximum([length(columns(e)); [c==0 ? cs : c+cs-1 for (_, _, c, cs) in requests]])
    areas=fill((0, 0, 0, 0), length(ordered))
    occupied=Set{Tuple{Int,Int}}()
    fits(r, c, rs, cs) = all(!((y, x) in occupied) for y in r:(r+rs-1) for x in c:(c+cs-1))
    function occupy!(i, r, c)
        _, rs, _, cs=requests[i]
        areas[i]=(r, c, rs, cs)
        for y in r:(r+rs-1), x in c:(c+cs-1)
            push!(occupied, (y, x))
        end
    end
    for (i, (r, _, c, _)) in enumerate(requests)
        r!=0 && c!=0 && occupy!(i, r, c)
    end
    cr=1
    cc=1
    for (i, (r, rs, c, cs)) in enumerate(requests)
        r!=0 && c!=0 && continue
        if r!=0
            c=1
            for candidate in 1:(nc-cs+1)
                if fits(r, candidate, rs, cs)
                    c=candidate
                    break
                end
            end
        elseif c!=0
            c<cc && (cr+=1)
            r=cr
            while !fits(r, c, rs, cs)
                r+=1
            end
            cr=r
            cc=c+cs
        else
            r=cr
            c=cc
            while true
                if c+cs-1>nc
                    r+=1
                    c=1
                elseif !fits(r, c, rs, cs)
                    c+=1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            cr=r
            cc=c+cs
        end
        occupy!(i, r, c)
    end
    areas, nc
end
function tracksizes(specs, n, available, gap, contributions)
    specifications=[specs; fill("auto", n-length(specs))]
    sizes=zeros(Int, n)
    for (i, s) in enumerate(specifications)
        if s=="auto" || (endswith(s, "fr") && available===nothing)
            sizes[i]=maximum(
                (v for (start, span, v) in contributions if start==i && span==1);
                init = 0,
            )
        elseif !endswith(s, "fr")
            sizes[i]=parse(Int, s)
        end
    end
    if available!==nothing
        leftover=available-sum(sizes)-gap*(n-1)
        weights=[endswith(s, "fr") ? parse(Int, s[1:(end-2)]) : 0 for s in specifications]
        all(==(0), weights) && (weights=Int[s=="auto" for s in specifications])
        leftover>0 && any(>(0), weights) && (sizes.+=distribute(leftover, weights))
    end
    sizes
end
spanstart(sizes, start, gap) = sum(@view sizes[1:(start-1)])+gap*(start-1)
spansize(sizes, start, span, gap) = sum(@view sizes[start:(start+span-1)])+gap*(span-1)
function maxcontent(d, i)
    d.intrinsic[i]>=0 && return d.intrinsic[i]
    e=d.elements[i]
    if e.text!==nothing
        result=length(e.text)
    elseif e.style["display"]=="flex" && e.style["flex-direction"] in ("row", "row-reverse")
        children=flow(d, e)
        result=sum((contribution(d, j) for j in children); init = 0)+gaptotal(
            parse(Int, e.style["column-gap"]),
            length(children),
        )
    elseif e.style["display"]=="grid"
        ordered=items(d, e)
        areas, nc=gridplacement(d, e, ordered)
        gap=parse(Int, e.style["column-gap"])
        contributions=[(a[2], a[4], contribution(d, j)) for (j, a) in zip(ordered, areas)]
        result=sum(tracksizes(columns(e), nc, nothing, gap, contributions))+gaptotal(gap, nc)
    else
        result=maximum((contribution(d, j) for j in flow(d, e)); init = 0)
    end
    d.intrinsic[i]=result
    result
end
function contribution(d, i)
    e=d.elements[i]
    width=resolvedlength(e, "width", nothing, true)
    width===nothing && (width=maxcontent(d, i))
    constrain(e, width, true, nothing)+outer(e, true)
end
function layout!(d, i, cwref, chref, fw = nothing, fh = nothing)
    e=d.elements[i]
    if fw===nothing
        width=resolvedlength(e, "width", cwref, true)
        fw=constrain(e, width===nothing ? max(0, cwref-outer(e, true)) : width, true, cwref)
    end
    if fh===nothing
        height=resolvedlength(e, "height", chref, false)
        height!==nothing && (fh=constrain(e, height, false, chref))
    end
    e.cw=fw
    if e.text!==nothing
        e.lines=wrapwords(e.text, fw)
        naturalheight=length(e.lines)
    elseif e.style["display"]=="flex"
        naturalheight=flexlayout!(d, i, fw, fh, chref)
    elseif e.style["display"]=="grid"
        naturalheight=gridlayout!(d, i, fw, fh)
    else
        bottom=0
        previous=0
        for j in flow(d, e)
            child=d.elements[j]
            layout!(d, j, fw, fh)
            top=bottom+max(previous, edge(child, "margin", "top"))
            placechild!(e, child, edge(child, "margin", "left"), top)
            bottom=top+borderheight(child)
            previous=edge(child, "margin", "bottom")
        end
        naturalheight=bottom+previous
    end
    e.ch=fh===nothing ? constrain(e, naturalheight, false, chref) : fh
    naturalheight
end
mutable struct FlexItem
    index::Int
    align::String
    outside::Int
    cross::Int
    base::Int
    hypothetical::Int
    size::Int
end
function main_sizes!(d, line, lengthmain, gap, horizontal, reference)
    gaps=gaptotal(gap, length(line))
    growing=sum(it.hypothetical+it.outside for it in line)+gaps<lengthmain
    weights=[
        parse(Int, d.elements[it.index].style[growing ? "flex-grow" : "flex-shrink"])*(
            growing ? 1 : it.base
        ) for it in line
    ]
    active=Int[]
    for (j, it) in enumerate(line)
        it.size=it.hypothetical
        weights[j]>0 &&
            (growing ? it.base<=it.hypothetical : it.base>=it.hypothetical) &&
            push!(active, j)
    end
    while !isempty(active)
        free=lengthmain-gaps-sum(
            (j in active ? it.base : it.size)+it.outside for (j, it) in enumerate(line)
        )
        shares=distribute(max(0, growing ? free : -free), weights[active])
        violations=zeros(Int, length(line))
        for (j, share) in zip(active, shares)
            it=line[j]
            tentative=it.base+(growing ? share : -share)
            it.size=constrain(d.elements[it.index], tentative, horizontal, reference)
            violations[j]=it.size-tentative
        end
        total=sum(violations)
        active=total>0 ? [j for j in active if violations[j]<=0] :
               total<0 ? [j for j in active if violations[j]>=0] : Int[]
    end
end
function justifyspaces(justify, remaining, n)
    spaces=zeros(Int, n)
    remaining<=0 && return spaces
    if justify=="end"
        spaces[1]=remaining
    elseif justify=="center"
        spaces[1]=div(remaining, 2)
    elseif justify!="start"
        ends, middle=justify=="space-between" ? (0, 1) : justify=="space-around" ? (1, 2) : (1, 1)
        weights=[ends; fill(middle, n-1); ends]
        sum(weights)>0 && (spaces=distribute(remaining, weights)[1:n])
    end
    spaces
end
function flexlayout!(d, index, cw, k, heightref)
    e=d.elements[index]
    direction=e.style["flex-direction"]
    horizontal=direction in ("row", "row-reverse")
    gap=parse(Int, e.style[horizontal ? "column-gap" : "row-gap"])
    rowgap=parse(Int, e.style["row-gap"])
    reference=horizontal ? cw : k
    allitems=FlexItem[]
    for j in items(d, e)
        child=d.elements[j]
        align=itemalign(e, child)
        cross=0
        if !horizontal
            room=max(0, cw-outer(child, true))
            crossvalue=resolvedlength(child, "width", cw, true)
            crossvalue===nothing &&
                (crossvalue=align=="stretch" ? room : min(maxcontent(d, j), room))
            cross=constrain(child, crossvalue, true, cw)
        end
        base=resolvedlength(child, "flex-basis", reference, horizontal)
        base===nothing &&
            (base=resolvedlength(child, horizontal ? "width" : "height", reference, horizontal))
        base===nothing && (base=horizontal ? maxcontent(d, j) : layout!(d, j, cw, k, cross))
        hypothetical=constrain(child, base, horizontal, reference)
        push!(allitems, FlexItem(j, align, outer(child, horizontal), cross, base, hypothetical, 0))
    end
    lengthmain=horizontal ? cw :
               k!==nothing ? k :
               constrain(
        e,
        sum((it.hypothetical+it.outside for it in allitems); init = 0)+gaptotal(
            gap,
            length(allitems),
        ),
        false,
        heightref,
    )
    lines=Vector{FlexItem}[]
    if horizontal && e.style["flex-wrap"]=="wrap"
        for it in allitems
            if !isempty(lines) &&
               sum(other.hypothetical+other.outside for other in lines[end])+gap*length(
                lines[end],
            )+it.hypothetical+it.outside<=lengthmain
                push!(lines[end], it)
            else
                push!(lines, [it])
            end
        end
    elseif !isempty(allitems)
        push!(lines, allitems)
    end
    crossstart=0
    totalcross=0
    for line in lines
        main_sizes!(d, line, lengthmain, gap, horizontal, reference)
        if horizontal
            for it in line
                layout!(d, it.index, cw, k, it.size)
                it.cross=d.elements[it.index].ch
            end
            largest=maximum(it.cross+outer(d.elements[it.index], false) for it in line)
            lc=length(lines)>1 ? largest : k!==nothing ? k : constrain(e, largest, false, heightref)
        else
            lc=cw
        end
        remaining=lengthmain-sum(it.size+it.outside for it in line)-gaptotal(gap, length(line))
        spaces=justifyspaces(e.style["justify-content"], remaining, length(line))
        backwards=endswith(direction, "-reverse")
        cursor=backwards ? lengthmain : 0
        for (it, space) in zip(line, spaces)
            child=d.elements[it.index]
            amount=it.size+it.outside
            if backwards
                cursor-=space+amount
                mainposition=cursor
                cursor-=gap
            else
                cursor+=space
                mainposition=cursor
                cursor+=amount+gap
            end
            mainposition+=edge(child, "margin", horizontal ? "left" : "top")
            if !horizontal
                layout!(d, it.index, cw, k, it.cross, it.size)
            elseif it.align=="stretch" && child.style["height"]=="auto"
                it.cross=constrain(child, max(0, lc-outer(child, false)), false, k)
                layout!(d, it.index, cw, k, it.size, it.cross)
            else
                layout!(d, it.index, cw, k, it.size)
            end
            offset=alignoffset(it.align, lc-it.cross-outer(child, !horizontal))
            if horizontal
                placechild!(e, child, mainposition, crossstart+offset+edge(child, "margin", "top"))
            else
                placechild!(e, child, crossstart+offset+edge(child, "margin", "left"), mainposition)
            end
        end
        totalcross+=lc
        crossstart+=lc+rowgap
    end
    horizontal ? totalcross+gaptotal(rowgap, length(lines)) : lengthmain
end
function gridlayout!(d, index, cw, k)
    e=d.elements[index]
    ordered=items(d, e)
    areas, nc=gridplacement(d, e, ordered)
    cg=parse(Int, e.style["column-gap"])
    rg=parse(Int, e.style["row-gap"])
    colcontrib=[(a[2], a[4], contribution(d, j)) for (j, a) in zip(ordered, areas)]
    cols=tracksizes(columns(e), nc, cw, cg, colcontrib)
    widths=Tuple{Int,Int}[]
    rowcontrib=NTuple{3,Int}[]
    for (j, a) in zip(ordered, areas)
        child=d.elements[j]
        aw=spansize(cols, a[2], a[4], cg)
        width=resolvedlength(child, "width", aw, true)
        gw=constrain(child, width===nothing ? max(0, aw-outer(child, true)) : width, true, aw)
        layout!(d, j, aw, nothing, gw)
        push!(widths, (aw, gw))
        push!(rowcontrib, (a[1], a[3], child.ch+outer(child, false)))
    end
    specifications=tracks(e, "grid-template-rows")
    nr=maximum([length(specifications); [a[1]+a[3]-1 for a in areas]])
    rows=tracksizes(specifications, nr, k, rg, rowcontrib)
    for (j, a, (aw, gw)) in zip(ordered, areas, widths)
        child=d.elements[j]
        ah=spansize(rows, a[1], a[3], rg)
        align=itemalign(e, child)
        if align=="stretch" && child.style["height"]=="auto"
            fh=constrain(child, max(0, ah-outer(child, false)), false, ah)
            layout!(d, j, aw, ah, gw, fh)
        else
            layout!(d, j, aw, ah, gw)
        end
        offset=alignoffset(align, ah-child.ch-outer(child, false))
        placechild!(
            e,
            child,
            spanstart(cols, a[2], cg)+edge(child, "margin", "left"),
            spanstart(rows, a[1], rg)+offset+edge(child, "margin", "top"),
        )
    end
    sum(rows)+gaptotal(rg, nr)
end
function ancestor(d, i)
    p=d.elements[i].parent
    while p!=0 && d.elements[p].style["position"]=="static"
        p=d.elements[p].parent
    end
    p
end
borderbox(e) = (e.x, e.y, borderwidth(e), borderheight(e))
marginbox(e) = (
    e.x-edge(e, "margin", "left"),
    e.y-edge(e, "margin", "top"),
    e.cw+outer(e, true),
    e.ch+outer(e, false),
)
paddingbox(e) = (
    e.x+edge(e, "border", "left"),
    e.y+edge(e, "border", "top"),
    e.cw+edge(e, "padding", "left")+edge(e, "padding", "right"),
    e.ch+edge(e, "padding", "top")+edge(e, "padding", "bottom"),
)
contentbox(e) = (
    e.x+edge(e, "border", "left")+edge(e, "padding", "left"),
    e.y+edge(e, "border", "top")+edge(e, "padding", "top"),
    e.cw,
    e.ch,
)
absoffset(start, finish, ms, me, free) =
    start!==nothing ? start+ms : finish!==nothing ? free-finish-me : ms
relshift(start, finish) = start!==nothing ? start : finish!==nothing ? -finish : 0
function performlayout!(d)
    fill!(d.intrinsic, -1)
    for e in d.elements
        e.displayed=e.style["display"]!="none" && (e.parent==0 || d.elements[e.parent].displayed)
    end
    root=d.elements[1]
    if root.displayed && root.style["position"]!="absolute"
        layout!(d, 1, d.width, d.height)
        root.rx=edge(root, "margin", "left")
        root.ry=edge(root, "margin", "top")
    end
    for (i, e) in enumerate(d.elements)
        e.displayed && e.style["position"]=="absolute" || continue
        p=ancestor(d, i)
        bw=p==0 ? d.width : paddingbox(d.elements[p])[3]
        bh=p==0 ? d.height : paddingbox(d.elements[p])[4]
        top, right, bottom, left=(inset(e, side) for side in SIDES)
        width=resolvedlength(e, "width", bw, true)
        if width===nothing
            room=max(0, bw-something(left, 0)-something(right, 0)-outer(e, true))
            width=left!==nothing && right!==nothing ? room : min(maxcontent(d, i), room)
        end
        fw=constrain(e, width, true, bw)
        fh=nothing
        if e.style["height"]=="auto" && top!==nothing && bottom!==nothing
            fh=constrain(e, max(0, bh-top-bottom-outer(e, false)), false, bh)
        end
        layout!(d, i, bw, bh, fw, fh)
        e.rx=absoffset(
            left,
            right,
            edge(e, "margin", "left"),
            edge(e, "margin", "right"),
            bw-borderwidth(e),
        )
        e.ry=absoffset(
            top,
            bottom,
            edge(e, "margin", "top"),
            edge(e, "margin", "bottom"),
            bh-borderheight(e),
        )
    end
    for (i, e) in enumerate(d.elements)
        e.displayed || continue
        p=e.style["position"]=="absolute" ? ancestor(d, i) : e.parent
        ox, oy=p==0 ? (0, 0) :
               e.style["position"]=="absolute" ? paddingbox(d.elements[p])[1:2] :
               (d.elements[p].x, d.elements[p].y)
        e.x=ox+e.rx
        e.y=oy+e.ry
        if e.style["position"]=="relative"
            e.x+=relshift(inset(e, "left"), inset(e, "right"))
            e.y+=relshift(inset(e, "top"), inset(e, "bottom"))
        end
    end
end
snapshot(d) = [e.displayed ? borderbox(e) : nothing for e in d.elements]
function changes(d, before)
    ids=[e.id for (e, old, new) in zip(d.elements, before, snapshot(d)) if old!=new]
    isempty(ids) ? "no change" : join(ids, ' ')
end
boxtext(box) = join(box, ' ')
function overflows(d, e)
    e.text!==nothing && return maximum(length, e.lines)>e.cw || length(e.lines)>e.ch
    x, y, w, h=contentbox(e)
    for j in flow(d, e)
        a, b, c, f=marginbox(d.elements[j])
        (a<x || b<y || a+c>x+w || b+f>y+h) && return true
    end
    false
end
function render(d)
    screen=fill('.', d.height, d.width)
    for e in d.elements
        e.displayed || continue
        x, y, w, h=borderbox(e)
        for yy in max(0, y):(min(d.height, y+h)-1), xx in max(0, x):(min(d.width, x+w)-1)
            onrow=(edge(e, "border", "top")==1 && yy==y) ||
                  (edge(e, "border", "bottom")==1 && yy==y+h-1)
            oncol=(edge(e, "border", "left")==1 && xx==x) ||
                  (edge(e, "border", "right")==1 && xx==x+w-1)
            screen[yy+1, xx+1]=onrow ? (oncol ? '+' : '-') : (oncol ? '|' : ' ')
        end
        if e.text!==nothing
            tx, ty, _, _=contentbox(e)
            for (row, text) in enumerate(e.lines), (col, c) in enumerate(text)
                xx=tx+col-1
                yy=ty+row-1
                0<=xx<d.width && 0<=yy<d.height && (screen[yy+1, xx+1]=c)
            end
        end
    end
    println("render $(d.width)x$(d.height)")
    boundary=repeat("#", d.width+2)
    println(boundary)
    for row in eachrow(screen)
        println("#", join(row), "#")
    end
    println(boundary)
end
function execute!(d, line)
    p=String.(split(line, ' '; limit = 4))
    command=p[1]
    if command=="LAYOUT"
        println("layout $(d.width)x$(d.height)")
        for e in d.elements
            println(repeat("  ", e.depth), e.id, " ", e.displayed ? boxtext(borderbox(e)) : "none")
        end
    elseif command=="BOX"
        i=findfirst(e->e.id==p[2], d.elements)
        if i===nothing
            println("error: unknown element $(p[2])")
        elseif !d.elements[i].displayed
            println("box $(p[2]): none")
        else
            e=d.elements[i]
            println("box $(e.id)")
            for (kind, box) in (
                ("margin", marginbox(e)),
                ("border", borderbox(e)),
                ("padding", paddingbox(e)),
                ("content", contentbox(e)),
            )
                println(kind, " ", boxtext(box))
            end
        end
    elseif command=="RENDER"
        render(d)
    elseif command=="HIT"
        x=parse(Int, p[2])
        y=parse(Int, p[3])
        if x>=d.width || y>=d.height
            println("error: point $x $y outside viewport")
            return
        end
        target=0
        for (i, e) in enumerate(d.elements)
            a, b, w, h=borderbox(e)
            e.displayed && a<=x<a+w && b<=y<b+h && (target=i)
        end
        path=String[]
        while target!=0
            pushfirst!(path, d.elements[target].id)
            target=d.elements[target].parent
        end
        println("hit $x $y: ", isempty(path) ? "none" : join(path, " > "))
    elseif command=="SET"
        id, property, value=p[2:4]
        i=findfirst(e->e.id==id, d.elements)
        if i===nothing
            println("error: unknown element $id")
            return
        end
        if !known_property(property)
            println("error: unknown property $property")
            return
        end
        declarations=expanddecl(property, value)
        if declarations===nothing
            println("error: invalid value for $property: $value")
            return
        end
        before=snapshot(d)
        merge!(d.elements[i].style, Dict(declarations))
        performlayout!(d)
        println("set $id $property $value: $(changes(d,before))")
    elseif command=="VIEWPORT"
        w=parse(Int, p[2])
        h=parse(Int, p[3])
        if !(1<=w<=80 && 1<=h<=40)
            println("error: invalid viewport $w $h")
            return
        end
        before=snapshot(d)
        d.width=w
        d.height=h
        performlayout!(d)
        println("viewport $w $h: $(changes(d,before))")
    elseif command=="OVERFLOW"
        ids=[e.id for e in d.elements if e.displayed && overflows(d, e)]
        println("overflow: ", isempty(ids) ? "none" : join(ids, ' '))
    else
        println("error: unknown command $command")
    end
end
function main()
    w, h=parse.(Int, split(readline()))
    rules=Tuple{Vector{String},Vector{Pair{String,String}}}[]
    while true
        line=readline()
        line=="---" && break
        selectors, body=split(line, " { "; limit = 2)
        declarations=Pair{String,String}[]
        for declaration in split(body[1:(end-2)], "; ")
            property, value=String.(split(declaration, ": "; limit = 2))
            expanded=expanddecl(property, value)
            expanded!==nothing && append!(declarations, expanded)
        end
        push!(rules, (String.(split(selectors, ", ")), declarations))
    end
    elements=CssElement[]
    stack=Int[]
    while true
        line=readline()
        line=="===" && break
        head=lstrip(line, ' ')
        depth=div(length(line)-length(head), 2)
        pieces=split(head, ' '; limit = 2)
        tag, names=split(pieces[1], '#')
        names=String.(split(names, '.'))
        text=length(pieces)==2 ? String(pieces[2][2:(end-1)]) : nothing
        resize!(stack, depth)
        parent=isempty(stack) ? 0 : stack[end]
        e=CssElement(
            String(tag),
            names[1],
            names[2:end],
            text,
            parent,
            depth,
            Int[],
            copy(INITIAL),
            false,
            0,
            0,
            String[],
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
        )
        winners=Dict{String,Int}()
        for (selectors, declarations) in rules
            specificity=-1
            for selector in selectors
                score=startswith(selector, "#") ? (selector[2:end]==e.id ? 2 : -1) :
                      startswith(selector, ".") ? (selector[2:end] in e.classes ? 1 : -1) :
                      (selector==e.tag ? 0 : -1)
                specificity=max(specificity, score)
            end
            specificity<0 && continue
            for (property, value) in declarations
                if specificity>=get(winners, property, -1)
                    winners[property]=specificity
                    e.style[property]=value
                end
            end
        end
        push!(elements, e)
        parent!=0 && push!(elements[parent].children, length(elements))
        push!(stack, length(elements))
    end
    document=Document(w, h, elements, fill(-1, length(elements)))
    performlayout!(document)
    while true
        line=readline()
        line=="END" && break
        execute!(document, line)
    end
end
main()
